▶
WASD
Throttle / steer / brake & reverse (arrow keys work too)
STEER
Commit to a turn at speed and the tail snaps out. Steer in to tighten, let go to hold, counter-steer to straighten. Long slides store a mini-turbo.
SPACE
Handbrake flick: bigger, harder snap into the drift.
SHIFT
Boost. Drains the meter, drifting refills it.
R
Tap to respawn on the road. Hold to restart the run.
C
Chase / hood camera
◀ ▶ PICK CAR · ENTER TO START
Timer starts at the gantry. Cyan chevrons are boost pads, rings refill boost. The chasm jump needs speed: hit the pad before the ramp. Best lap is saved and raced as a ghost.
